description: This file defines an enumeration `XFontStretchValue` representing different font stretch styles (e.g., condensed, expanded) based on WPF values, and a static class `XFontStretches` that provides static properties for common stretch values, as well as helper methods for string conversion and parsing related to font stretch. The file appears to be part of the PDFsharp library, specifically dealing with font stretching functionality in drawing operations.

classes.name: XFontStretches
classes.description: Provides static predefined values for font stretchings, with methods to parse from strings and convert to string representations.

methods.name: UltraCondensed
methods.description: Returns an `XFontStretch` instance representing ultra-condensed font stretch.

methods.name: ExtraCondensed
methods.description: Returns an `XFontStretch` instance representing extra-condensed font stretch.

methods.name: Condensed
methods.description: Returns an `XFontStretch` instance representing condensed font stretch.

methods.name: SemiCondensed
methods.description: Returns an `XFontStretch` instance representing semi-condensed font stretch.

methods.name: Normal
methods.description: Returns an `XFontStretch` instance representing normal font stretch.

methods.name: Medium
methods.description: Returns an `XFontStretch` instance representing medium (same as normal) font stretch.

methods.name: SemiExpanded
methods.description: Returns an `XFontStretch` instance representing semi-expanded font stretch.

methods.name: Expanded
methods.description: Returns an `XFontStretch` instance representing expanded font stretch.

methods.name: ExtraExpanded
methods.description: Returns an `XFontStretch` instance representing extra-expanded font stretch.

methods.name: UltraExpanded
methods.description: Returns an `XFontStretch` instance representing ultra-expanded font stretch.

methods.name: XFontStretchStringToKnownStretch
methods.description: Converts a string to a known `XFontStretch` value, updating the reference parameter if successful.

methods.name: XFontStretchToString
methods.description: Converts an `XFontStretchValue` to its string representation.

methods.name: FontStretchFromFaceName
methods.description: Parses a font face name string to determine the corresponding `XFontStretch` value.
